skins.name: 蓝色幻想
skins.author: powerdog996（DreamSkin 社区）· dsh-web-ui 适配
skins.notesZh: 青蓝幻想风格 DSH Web UI 皮肤（出自 @linxin666/dsh-skins 打包分发）。
skins.notesEn: Blue fantasy themed DSH Web UI skin (bundled from @linxin666/dsh-skins).
skins.compatZh: ⚠️ 中度错位：主区域（输入框花框/分隔线）正常，但侧栏会话列表上会浮现装饰气泡、遮挡会话文字（上游装饰层选择器在 RC2 上打偏）。可正常使用，介意者等上游适配。
skins.compatEn: ⚠️ Moderate: main area is fine, but decorative bubbles float over sidebar session text (upstream decoration selectors drift on RC2). Usable; wait for upstream fix if it bothers you.

skins.name: 龙的传人
skins.author: dsh-web-ui
skins.notesZh: 龙裔风格 DSH Web UI 皮肤。
skins.notesEn: Dragon-heir themed DSH Web UI skin.
skins.compatZh: ✅ 适配良好：长城巨龙壁纸 + 淡雅红色点缀，布局干净无错位。
skins.compatEn: ✅ Good: Great-Wall dragon wallpaper with subtle red accents; clean layout, no misplacement.

skins.name: 初音未来 · 电子歌姬
skins.author: 涂山苏苏
skins.notesZh: 初音未来主题 DSH Web UI 皮肤。
skins.notesEn: Hatsune Miku themed DSH Web UI skin.
skins.compatZh: ✅ 适配良好：整壳换肤完整（标题栏/壁纸/状态栏），无错位。
skins.compatEn: ✅ Good: full-shell reskin (title bar / wallpaper / status bar) with no misplacement.

skins.name: Minecraft 方块世界
skins.author: dsh-web-ui
skins.notesZh: Minecraft 像素主题 DSH Web UI 皮肤。
skins.notesEn: Minecraft pixel themed DSH Web UI skin.
skins.compatZh: ✅ 适配良好：像素主题完整（像素按钮/像素字体），文字清晰。
skins.compatEn: ✅ Good: pixel theme applies fully (pixel buttons / pixel font); text stays crisp.

skins.name: QQ2008 怀旧版
skins.author: dsh-web-ui
skins.notesZh: QQ98 复古 Windows 主题 DSH Web UI 皮肤。
skins.notesEn: QQ98 retro Windows themed DSH Web UI skin.
skins.compatZh: ⚠️ 轻度问题：QQ2008 复古风格完整，但蓝色侧栏上的次要文字（会话时间戳、「展开其余」项）对比度偏低、不易读。
skins.compatEn: ⚠️ Minor: the QQ2008 retro style applies, but secondary text on the blue sidebar (session timestamps, "show more") has low contrast.

skins.name: 同花顺风格
skins.author: dsh-web-ui
skins.notesZh: THS 主题 DSH Web UI 皮肤。
skins.notesEn: THS themed DSH Web UI skin.
skins.compatZh: ❌ 明显问题：同花顺红金标题栏/行情条正常，但深色侧栏上的会话文字与工作区名称几乎不可见（文字颜色被主题覆盖）。当前版本不建议启用。
skins.compatEn: ❌ Notable: the THS red title bar and tickers render, but sidebar session/workspace text is nearly invisible (text color overridden by the theme). Not recommended for now.

skins.name: 交易终端
skins.author: dsh-web-ui
skins.notesZh: 交易终端风格 DSH Web UI 皮肤。
skins.notesEn: Trading-terminal styled DSH Web UI skin.
skins.compatZh: ✅ 适配良好：行情顶栏/底栏 + 侧栏文字清晰，无错位。
skins.compatEn: ✅ Good: market ticker bars render; sidebar text crisp; no misplacement.

skins.name: 鲸吟
skins.author: dsh-web-ui
skins.notesZh: 鲸歌主题 DSH Web UI 皮肤。
skins.notesEn: Whale-song themed DSH Web UI skin.
skins.compatZh: ✅ 适配良好：浅蓝鲸歌主题，布局干净无错位。
skins.compatEn: ✅ Good: light-blue whale theme; clean layout, no misplacement.

skins.name: Windows XP (Luna)
skins.author: dsh-web-ui
skins.notesZh: Windows XP 复古主题 DSH Web UI 皮肤。
skins.notesEn: Windows XP retro themed DSH Web UI skin.
skins.compatZh: ✅ 适配良好：Luna 蓝标题栏 + 底部任务栏复刻完整，无错位。
skins.compatEn: ✅ Good: Luna title bar and bottom task bar reproduced; no misplacement.

skins.name: 深鲸管理器
skins.author: Small-tailqwq
skins.mutexZh: 本条目为皮肤切换管理器：client-ui 皮肤之间互斥，经管理器统一切换，请勿叠装多个皮肤。已装 @linxin666/dsh-web-all 的环境请使用其皮肤中心适配版，不能叠装 standalone 版。
skins.mutexEn: This entry is the skin switch manager: client-ui skins are mutually exclusive and switched via the manager; do not stack multiple skins. On hosts with @linxin666/dsh-web-all installed, use its skin-center adapter build instead of this standalone package.
skins.notesZh: 深鲸系列皮肤切换管理器（社区 @smalltailqwq 版），提供皮肤面板与统一切换入口。
skins.notesEn: Deep-whale series skin manager (community edition by @smalltailqwq) providing a skin panel and unified switcher.
skins.compatZh: 未逐项目录化：本皮肤面向 AIO/EAC 分叉版 Web UI 制作，在官方 RC2 上可能存在不同程度的装饰层错位（选择器漂移），属上游适配问题，不影响安装与启用。
skins.compatEn: Not itemized: this skin targets the AIO/EAC fork web UI and may show varying degrees of decoration misplacement on official RC2 (selector drift) — an upstream issue that does not affect install/enable.

skins.name: 深海女仆工坊
skins.author: Small-tailqwq
skins.mutexZh: 同皮肤新旧两版互斥（旧 @dsh-external 0.0.1 已退役）：不可与旧版叠装。client-ui 皮肤之间互斥，不可叠装（deep-whale-manager 为统一切换管理器）。已装 @linxin666/dsh-web-all 的环境请使用其皮肤中心适配版，不能叠装 standalone 版。
skins.mutexEn: Old and new builds of this skin are mutually exclusive (legacy @dsh-external 0.0.1 is retired); do not stack them. client-ui skins are mutually exclusive and must not be stacked (deep-whale-manager is the unified switcher). On hosts with @linxin666/dsh-web-all installed, use its skin-center adapter build instead of this standalone package.
skins.notesZh: 女仆工坊风格 DSH Web UI 皮肤（鲸鱼娘美术系列社区版，取代旧 @dsh-external 0.0.1 提取版）。
skins.notesEn: Maid-atelier themed DSH Web UI skin (community whale-art series, superseding the old @dsh-external 0.0.1 extraction).
skins.compatZh: 💥 禁用启用按钮：真机实测启用本皮肤会导致官方 v0.2.0-rc.2 Web UI 渲染进程崩溃循环（主进程内存膨胀、CDP 失联），需从 profile 清单摘除才能恢复。等上游适配 RC2 后再启用。
skins.compatEn: 💥 Enable disabled: enabling this skin crashed the official v0.2.0-rc.2 web UI in real-machine testing (renderer crash loop, main-process memory balloon). Wait for an upstream RC2-compatible build.

skins.notesZh: 虎鲸主题 DSH Web UI 皮肤（鲸鱼娘美术系列社区版）。
skins.notesEn: Orca-themed DSH Web UI skin (community whale-art series).
skins.compatZh: ✅ 适配良好（社区）：黑白水墨虎鲸立绘 + 标语文案，会话树缩进线清晰，无错位。
skins.compatEn: ✅ Good (community): ink-wash orca artwork and slogan; clean session tree; no misplacement.

skins.author: kingOfSoySauce
skins.mutexZh: 同皮肤新旧两版互斥（旧 @dsh-external 0.0.1 已退役）：不可与旧版叠装。client-ui 皮肤之间互斥，不可叠装（deep-whale-manager 为统一切换管理器）。已装 @linxin666/dsh-web-all 的环境请使用其皮肤中心适配版，不能叠装 standalone 版。

skins.notesEn: Intensity-adjustable 'sliding rheostat' theme skin, distributed as a release tarball by kingOfSoySauce (~45MB before v0.1.7, ~1.3MB since).
skins.compatZh: ⚠️ 轻度问题：滑动变阻器特色滑块正常，但「新会话」按钮灰底灰字对比度偏低；其余布局正常。
skins.compatEn: ⚠️ Minor: the signature slider works, but the "New Session" button is grey-on-grey (low contrast); otherwise fine.

skins.name: 昼夜工坊
skins.author: GGBond2424648901
skins.mutexZh: 同皮肤新旧两版互斥（旧 @dsh-external 0.0.1 已退役）：不可与旧版叠装。client-ui 皮肤之间互斥，不可叠装（deep-whale-manager 为统一切换管理器）。已装 @linxin666/dsh-web-all 的环境请使用其皮肤中心适配版，不能叠装 standalone 版。
skins.mutexEn: Old and new builds of this skin are mutually exclusive (legacy @dsh-external 0.0.1 is retired); do not stack them. client-ui skins are mutually exclusive and must not be stacked (deep-whale-manager is the unified switcher). skins.notesZh: 昼夜双主题工坊皮肤（GGBond2424648901 经 GitHub Release 分发 tgz，随包附 SHA256SUMS；npm 包名与仓库名不同）。
skins.notesEn: Day/night dual-theme workshop skin (tgz from GGBond2424648901's GitHub releases, ships with SHA256SUMS; npm package name differs from repo name).
skins.compatZh: ⚠️ 中度错位：昼/夜双主题与鲸鱼娘立绘正常，但侧栏会话文字被装饰气泡/立绘部分遮挡（与 blue-fantasy 同源装饰系统）。带「夜间」切换钮。
skins.compatEn: ⚠️ Moderate: day/night themes and artwork render, but sidebar session text is partly covered by decorations (same decoration system as blue-fantasy). Includes the day/night toggle.

skins.name: 终末地
skins.author: ymh0000123
skins.mutexZh: 同皮肤新旧两版互斥（旧 @dsh-external 0.0.1 已退役）：不可与旧版叠装。client-ui 皮肤之间互斥，不可叠装（deep-whale-manager 为统一切换管理器）。已装 @linxin666/dsh-web-all 的环境请使用其皮肤中心适配版，不能叠装 standalone 版。
skins.mutexEn: Old and new builds of this skin are mutually exclusive (legacy @dsh-external 0.0.1 is retired); do not stack them. client-ui skins are mutually exclusive and must not be stacked (deep-whale-manager is the unified switcher). On hosts with @linxin666/dsh-web-all installed, use its skin-center adapter build instead of this standalone package.
skins.notesZh: 明日方舟：终末地风格主题 —— 奶油纸面、墨色文字、信号黄点缀、零圆角工业排版；设置项经 DSH 0.1.7 volatile Config + configForms 持久化。npm 版已 unpublish，改从 GitHub 仓库打包。
skins.notesEn: Arknights: Endfield styled theme — cream paper, ink text, signal-yellow accents, zero-radius industrial typography; settings persist via DSH 0.1.7 volatile Config + configForms. npm version unpublished; packaged from the GitHub repo.
skins.compatZh: ⚠️ 中度错位：整壳黑黄主题生效；但右下角状态指示器（status-rotator 插件）会错位到左上角并与菜单栏重叠——启用本皮肤时建议同时禁用 status-rotator 插件。
skins.compatEn: ⚠️ Moderate: the black/yellow theme applies, but the bottom-right status pill (status-rotator plugin) jumps to the top-left and overlaps the menu bar — disable status-rotator while using this skin.
